# PR Review: 01-messy-ts-app

Categorising against two axes: **severity** (how bad is the bug?) and **`agent_risk`** (how likely is a future agent to compound the problem because they can't see it clearly?). Block-merge means correctness-or-environment-breaking; warn means real risk but not a release blocker; ignore means signal too low to action in this PR.

## Block merge (5)

| ID | Charge | sev / agent_risk | Why blocking |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00007 | Dev-Server URL (`localhost:3000`) | 0.60 / 0.53 | `src/api/files.ts:8` will fail against every environment except a dev box running on port 3000. Production-path code, deterministic break. |
| 00008 | Localhost-on-Disk (`/Users/andrew/...`) | 0.60 / 0.53 | `src/api/files.ts:9` — the path exists on exactly one machine. CI, every teammate, and every deploy are broken on import. Cheap to fix, expensive to ship. |
| 00002 | Temporal Recklessness in `src/date.ts` (8 sites) | 0.80 / 0.62 | This file is the date module — if `Date.now()`/`new Date()` aren't injectable here, no downstream code is testable deterministically. Highest agent_risk in the report. |
| 00003 | Half-UTC, Half-Local on same receiver | 0.80 / 0.61 | `getUTCFullYear()` + `getMonth()` on `d` is a silent timezone-offset bug, not a style issue. Will produce wrong dates on every non-UTC host. |
| 00005 | God Function `generateInvoice` (204 lines) | 0.90 / 0.55 | Highest raw severity; an invoice generator at 3.4× threshold mixes concerns an agent will miss when patching one section. Blocks because it's the load-bearing path and #00019 says the same file already has 7 direct `Date` calls feeding it. |

## Warn (15)

| ID | Charge | sev / agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00001 | SVG With Embedded Raster | 0.75 / 0.70 | High sev/high agent_risk but it renders — perf/asset hygiene, not correctness. |
| 00004 | Concept Alias Drift (tenant/account/org/team/workspace) | 0.55 / 0.58 | Classic agent trap — agent extending one vocabulary will duplicate logic. Worth a follow-up issue. |
| 00006 | Missing Agent Context (no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) | 0.60 / 0.53 | Not a correctness bug, but every agent edit gets worse without it. |
| 00009 | Timezone Roulette (`"2026-12-25T07:00:00"`) | 0.60 / 0.53 | Silent bug, but isolated to two literals. |
| 00010 | String Sprinkles (`"enterprise"` × 4 files) | 0.50 / 0.52 | Already duplicated policy in waiting. |
| 00011 | DST-Naive Day Math (`+ 86400000`) | 0.60 / 0.52 | One site, real DST risk. |
| 00015 | Duplicated Navigation Source (`/settings/billing` → Plans / Billing) | 0.60 / 0.49 | Two truth sources for the same destination — pair with #00017. |
| 00017 | Route Metadata Drift (4 competing labels for `/settings/billing`) | 0.60 / 0.49 | Same destination as #00015 — fix together. |
| 00019 | Temporal Recklessness in `src/billing.ts` (7 sites) | 0.60 / 0.46 | Downgraded from #00002 because billing should consume an injected clock, not own one. Fix follows #00002. |
| 00020 | Test That Proves Nothing (`renders the enterprise plan`, 0 asserts) | 0.45 / 0.46 | False confidence is worse than no test — agents will assume billing is covered. |
| 00021 | False Identity (`calculateRefundPreview` does I/O) | 0.55 / 0.44 | Innocuous-looking name, real side effects. Agent will treat it as pure. |
| 00026 | God File (`billing.ts` 310 / 300) | 0.60 / 0.42 | Only 10 lines over — co-resolve with #00005. |
| 00027 | Logic in the Alibi (refund rule in comment) | 0.50 / 0.42 | Prose-only authorisation rule near refund code is a real safety gap. |
| 00031 | Return Shape Roulette (`resolvePaymentResult`) | 0.30 / 0.40 | Low sev but 0% key overlap across return branches — callers will guess wrong. |
| 00033 | Plural Mismatch (`users: User`, `invoice: Invoice[]`) | 0.30 / 0.40 | Either a typo or a real shape bug; cheap to verify. |

## Ignore (17)

Stylistic / aesthetic / tiny — flag in a sweep PR, don't gate this one:

- **00012, 00013, 00014** — asset/docs hygiene (253KB PNG, broken `setup.md` link, 32×32 icon as PNG). Real, but low signal.
- **00016, 00038** — TODO density (the high-density one is in `src/todo.ts` — almost certainly fixture intent; the billing one is 12.9/kLOC, just over the 10 threshold).
- **00022** — sync I/O in `loadPlanSchema` — schema loader, plausibly one-shot at boot. Verify, then ignore.
- **00023, 00024, 00025** — single-site date hygiene (one `Date.now()`, one `+`-concat, one `toLocaleDateString()`). Will fall out of fixing #00002.
- **00028, 00029** — unprefixed booleans. Style.
- **00030, 00032** — option-bag and double-negative in `petty.ts`. Naming smell, no behavioural risk.
- **00034, 00035, 00036** — orphaned routes (`/account/subscription`, `/team`, `/workspace/members`). Could be in-flight work; ignore *in this PR* but raise as a follow-up question to the author.
- **00037** — weak matcher in `creates an invoice` test. Lower priority than #00020 which has *zero* asserts.

## Verdict

**Block.** Two environment-breaking literals (#00007, #00008) and three correctness/testability issues at the foundation of date + billing logic (#00002, #00003, #00005). Everything else can ship as follow-ups.
